name: 3rd party - CRM lead form
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3rd party - CRM lead form.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: This form sends a native browser request to your configured endpoint. Your CRM/provider must accept these field names, process consent and validate captcha server-side. The theme does not install a CRM integration or confirm lead delivery.

Use manual content first if no matching definition exists. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.
